sections.heading: Parameter modes
sections.markdown:
- `name: T` is the default READ contract; `name: ref T` is an exclusive writable place loan; `name: move T` consumes a unique owner
- Calls to `ref` parameters must write `ref place`; existing owners passed to `move` parameters must write `move value`
- `copy(value)` creates a fresh owner and ordinary outputs use returns, tuples, structs, or Result

sections.heading: Checked system assertions
sections.markdown:
- `@no_alloc`, `@no_throw`, and `@no_suspend` are analyzer-proven, fail-closed contracts
- `@zero_cost` is an AOT generated-shape contract; its optional allow list names explicit residue exemptions
- `@no_throw` and `@no_suspend` may prefix function types to constrain callbacks

sections.heading: Higher-order functions
sections.markdown:
- Function types use `(T1, T2) -> R` in type position, optionally prefixed by `@no_throw` and/or `@no_suspend`
- Function values can be passed to callbacks such as `map`, `filter`, and `reduce`
- Unconstrained callback parameters are effect-polymorphic; explicit effect prefixes are fixed constraints
- Closure capture rules are described in the scoping and concurrency sections
